Subject: SI-CP-0007 cold plate qualification — request for additional information (SUP-07)

Dear Oscorp team,

Thank you for your qualification packet for the NPI liquid-cooling cold plate, part number SI-CP-0007, revision A (drawing SI-DWG-CP-0007). To complete our review, please send the following:

1. 1.capa — Corrective and preventive action: your documented CAPA procedure, with example records showing corrective actions tracked to closure.
2. 2.ctq_cpk — Process capability: a capability study with Cpk values for each CTQ (Base thickness, Port bore, Mounting-hole pitch), including sample size and raw data.
3. 3.grr — Gage R&R: measurement system analysis results, as % of tolerance, for every gauge used on the three CTQs.
4. 5.lot_trace — Lot traceability: a traceability record showing a shipment linked back to its raw-material lot.
5. 8.subtier_certs — Sub-tier certificates: copies of the current quality-system certificates you hold on file for your critical sub-tier supplier, Wakanda Design Group.

Please reply with these documents at your earliest convenience.

Regards,
Stark Industries Supplier Quality — Pepper Potts

audit_plan.question: capability_study.md §1.1 gives only a claim. On site, pull current production data for Base thickness (2.9–3.1 mm), Port bore (7.95–8.05 mm) and Mounting-hole pitch (79.9–80.1 mm) and compute Cpk for each; confirm sample size and that the data is from the production process.

msa.md §1.1 gives no %GRR. Witness or review a Gage R&R study for each CTQ gauge named in the drawing-specific measurement instructions (quality_manual.md §9.3) and record %GRR against the CTQ tolerance.

quality_manual.md §1.5 claims shipment-to-batch linkage. Pick a recent shipped lot and trace it end to end to the incoming aluminum (SI-MAT-AL-01) material lot and its certificate, including any Wakanda Design Group sub-tier steps.
